Weekly updates are the responsibility of the functional lead and help share progress, aid in tracking progress, communicate achievements and blockers, and openly discuss what's needed as we push forward. By keeping each week's updates in its own consolidated issue and in `github/enterprise-releases`, knowledge is centralized and easily discoverable. 

Functional leads should please plan to post a status update on **Thursday** of each week. See [this guide](https://github.com/github/technical-program-management/blob/main/guides-and-templates/guide-weekly-updates.md) for an overview of the reporting process. Whenever possible, please include relevant links.

#### To create a status update

1. Type `/status` in the issue comment box below and choose the "Status Template" option
2. Fill out the resulting [form](https://github.com/github/ghpi/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_COMMENT_TEMPLATE/engg-team-status.yml)
